notes: Classifies character IDs around 0x52-0x59 into special handling categories.
Categories 0 and 3 call FUN_800CD690 four times in the observed block.
Category 1 calls FUN_800CD690 two times in the observed block.
FUN_800CD690 adjusts r3 by 0x34 and tail-branches to FUN_800F7E98, preserving r4-r6.
FUN_800F7E98 writes param_4 to param_1 + param_2 * 0xC4 + param_3 * 4 + 8.
Category 2 skips the observed local_80 apply path.

functions.name: ApplyCharacterSpecialPart
notes: This wrapper adjusts the base pointer, then tail-branches to FUN_800F7E98.
Because this is a tail branch, r4-r6 are preserved for FUN_800F7E98.
The caller's apparent index/value arguments are consumed by FUN_800F7E98, not by the wrapper itself.

functions.name: SetIndexedSpecialPartValue
notes: After FUN_800CD690 adjusts r3 by 0x34, this writes into a strided table.
param_3 is the inner part index.
param_4 is the value written, observed as local_80[index] in the special category path.
